description: Rubric fixture for the domain-distillation behavior gate shipped in 4e783d3 / v2.30.6 (classify-first + text-function strategy + obey-project-assets). Source strings are synthetic, representative game-system phrases authored for this fixture, NOT client batch data. These cases are judged by a human against the rubric after a live SAME-MODEL run; they are intentionally NOT wired into any deterministic assertion test because model output is non-deterministic and an assertion would flake. RUNBOOK.md carries the exact pi command + verdict-recording procedure for each case.
modelNote: Pin the same model+effort the v0 baseline recorded (deepseek-v4-pro:xhigh). The gate change is a prompt change; using a different model would make a later scorecard delta unreadable.
judgedBy: human reviewer or an eval-pack rater — see RUNBOOK.md verdict table.

cases.pass: Returns the standard market-conventional UI string (e.g. "Inventory full" / "Bag is full") and plainly states the segment is informative/operational, so no transcreation is warranted.
cases.fail: Adds flavor, voice, or wordplay; 'creatively' rewrites a plain system label; claims a stylistic choice where convention is required.
cases.why: No evidence governs. The distillation says informative text's submission-ready answer is the conventional rendering, not transcreation. This case proves the gate suppresses gratuitous creativity on plain UI.

cases.sourceText: 「这把剑啊,砍过的牛比你吹过的还多。」
cases.expectedStrategy: commit to a strong localized choice + accountable expert rationale
cases.pass: Delivers a voiced, idiomatic en-US line that keeps the swagger/humor, plus a one-line expert rationale (voice/register/wordplay). Does NOT hand back a flat literal gloss.
cases.fail: Returns a flat literal gloss; refuses to commit; over-hedges with needs_review when no evidence is actually in conflict.
cases.why: Expressive/diegetic flavor is exactly where the distillation still licenses a strong localized choice. This case proves the gate did NOT over-correct into timidity on creative text.

cases.sourceText: 你并没有足够的采购数
cases.expectedStrategy: conventional rendering + honest flag (query / needs_review), not confident invention
cases.pass: Proposes the conventional system string (e.g. "Insufficient purchase attempts" / "Not enough purchases") AND routes the uncertainty through proposal_create with a query / needs_review rather than fabricating a confident clever rewrite.
cases.fail: Invents a flavorful or guessed string presented as final/confident; skips the query/needs_review path; silently overwrites.
cases.why: Operational text with a slightly ambiguous source is the canonical case: submission-ready = correct + conventional + honest flagging, never clever invention. This synthetic phrase anchors the ambiguity case.

cases.setup: Seed/confirm a project termbase entry so the source term has a governing target before the run (mirrors the existing agent:smoke 勇者徽记 + tm_lookup pattern).
cases.expectedStrategy: obey the project's own termbase target; cite it; do not self-invent
cases.pass: Looks the term up, returns the termbase-governed target, and cites the termbase as the authority. Linguistic taste does not override the asset.
cases.fail: Coins its own 'better' term and ignores the termbase; cites a tool trace as if it were evidence.
cases.why: Proves the obey-project-assets clause: the project's own assets outrank model judgment, and the authority hierarchy (locked > termbase > styleguide > model) is binding.
